facts.value: The receiving institution must be a university with whom the University of Limerick has a signed 'inter-institutional' agreement.
Check with UL Global prior to submitting your application to ensure the institution holds a valid mobility agreement with UL.
The minimum funded duration for staff mobility is 2 days (excluding travel).
The maximum funded duration for staff mobility is 7 days (including travel).
Faculty must fulfil a minimum of 8 teaching hours per week during their mobility.
